page.overview:
What is Gastly?

This Gastly is a wild /-type Pokémon that appeared in "The Ghost of Maiden's Peak". It possesses abilities that other Gastly lack, and its job is to ensure the survival of old legends.

Gastly's origins are unknown; how it gained the ability to speak, shapeshift, use telekinesis and hypnosis, and create illusions. At one point, it became friends with the Ghost of Maiden's Peak and promised to ensure her legend's survival and find her lost lover. It took the form of the maiden's ghost and had attracted many young men who arrived at Maiden's Peak and also took the form of an old woman to further manipulate them.

Gastly made its presence in the form of the Maiden's Ghost before revealing its true form to the viewers.

When Ash, his friends, and Team Rocket came to Maiden's Peak, it allowed Brock and James to see it (although Pikachu was able to catch a glimpse of its true form before it disappears) and later brought them to the Maiden's shrine. After a failed attempt at taking over Brock and James with its charm, due to being interrupted by Ash and co. (especially after Jessie shoots it with a bazooka), it resorted to using violence by summoning skull ghosts. It is soon revealed to be a Gastly by Ash's Pokédex. Impressed that Ash figured out who it was, it confesses that it was both the maiden's ghost and the old woman that they met before as it returns to its true form, merging with the skull ghosts in the process.
